answer: Each close, a seeded sample of agents gets a tide-gauge probe: sign the close root, a salt, and a three-word phrase cut from its own last sealed answer. The ocean of puppets drowns here — a farm stamping template text cannot re-derive a phrase from its own ledger without a live state machine per puppet. Passing probes stack into a horizon, the longest unbroken chain of verified epochs, and standing is paid by horizon depth. One failed probe burns the bond, and the marble core of the ledger records every probe in public, so a farm must run months of genuine per-puppet history or eat the burn.
